'''2000 Pennsylvania State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship on 25 March 2000. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d383">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-pa-state-championships-3-25-00d383/ pa-state-championships-3-25-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 26 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-pa-state-championships-3-25-00d383/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 March 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
